w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Stanley is calling it "Old Gavel." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
